newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures end strongly higher.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures end strongly higher.

text.p: Aug 19 - Most U.S. stock index futures ended with strong gains, pushed to new session highs late. Sept S&P 500 ended near 932.00 session peak, above resistance band from 925.00 to 929.00. Tech stocks and Dell earnings fueled the late move, traders said. Sept S&P 500 futures overall volume pegged at 63,000 contracts. Traders called late action moderate.
